cityScopes.auckland: Auckland city-scoped verification of the shared LINZ current primary-parcel publication. The initial 13 aligned cells and four adjacent pans were expanded to 30 cells, a wider viewport and four pans around the unchanged WUP locator, yielding 184 distinct full parcel geometries. All 47 checks passed with the existing runtime descriptor: page size 100, native id identity, OBJECTID transport manifests, and safe appellation/topology labels. Forced three-row paging completed in 48 geometry pages; all 184 fresh native-id reads reproduced geometry; explicit absence, full footprint lookup and complete proposal binding passed. The WUP-containing native parcel 5211850 also matched its prior full geometry. GEOS in EPSG:32760 found no invalid polygons, duplicate geometry, sampled overlaps above 0.01 m² or operation errors. The shared Wellington runtime settings are retained. Current primary parcels only; non-primary interests, historic/pending parcels, whole-city completeness, source publication freshness and identity continuity after revision remain unverified. Retain LINZ attribution and CC BY 4.0 conditions; source accuracy notices remain informational.

evidence: LINZ describes NZ Primary Parcels as current primary cadastral parcel polygons for New Zealand, including fee-simple and Maori land, roads and other primary interests: https://data.linz.govt.nz/layer/50772-nz-primary-parcels/

The first-party LINZ dataset links ArcGIS item 7442ad2e98534d67a3c45df9b7fbcf5e to this public national polygon service; the unchanged Glenfield point returns native parcel 5176177. See evidence/official-item.json, evidence/official-layer-schema.json and evidence/native-query-preflight.json.
